data.scope: Supervised rows restricted to six clubs; all their EPL opponents included. League results used only as opponent context.
data.license_note: Public website access does not assert an open redistribution license; ESPN endpoint undocumented.
data.missing_data: No formation inferred. Missing lineup/stats retained, coverage exported. Provider per-player match stats used only after date.

protocol.test_refit: Before each test season, all earlier seasons; configurations frozen
protocol.honesty_note: 2024-2026 outcomes were previously evaluated in v2. This is a retrospective held-out comparison, not a fresh prospective test.
protocol.scope: Only selected-club rows are supervised. Non-cohort opponent league histories are context.
protocol.recommendation_rule: Exploratory formation scores only; no causal optimal formation claimed

features.lineup_note: Current starting identities only; player productivity from earlier observed selected-club fixtures. No career/ability or injury claims.
features.context_note: All EPL opponent result histories are context, never supervised non-cohort team rows.

limitations: Club focus alone does not increase games per club; longer history does.
Historic squads/managers differ. Recency weighting cannot identify causal effects.
No timestamped injury/availability snapshots or guaranteed pre-kickoff formation timestamps.
Player histories cover previously collected fixtures, not full careers.
League-context opponent histories are collected separately from the selected supervised rows.
Holdout seasons already appeared in v2; retrospective test with no v3 tuning on them.
